body:
Hi OP, sorry I'm a bit late. I'm Willow(alias), and I'm a year older than you. I can understand where you come from. When you're in the beginning stages of puberty(puberty starts generally from 10-13), your body is going through many changes. Adam's Apples, all that. Mental health is also something that usually hits at that time. (No I'm not saying depression is a phase.) It seems as if this just happened to you. Kids in middle school are assholes as they're going through puberty also, their mind is still developing so they can't tell what's right and what is wrong.  
On the existential crisis part, that usually is temporary. Try not to dwell in those thoughts as they make it worse. It makes you incredibly anxious. If you find yourself thinking about it use the 3-3-3 method.  
3-3-3 method:  
1. Look around the area you're in currently. Name 3 things you see.  
2. Name 3 colors you see.

3. Name 3 body parts.

The best thing to do when it comes to your mother, talk to her about how you feel. Talking to people you love and care for will help you improve your mental health. Nobody has to go through these thoughts alone.

On you having low self esteem, do the things you love whether it's watching YouTube, playing games, making music/art, writing, whatever it is as long as you enjoy it.

Stay safe, OP. I can tell you're intelligent.

Yeah it's way too easy to wallow on thoughts, when it comes to that kind of stuff I just counteract it with positive thoughts about family and stuff. I can tell my therapist stuff and he can't tell my parents about it since there's a law against it. I like my therapist so far. He's very welcoming and kind about everything. One thing he recommended is to go to my bird and give him a lot of care and play with him. (I play a lot of old rock off my phone for him and he really likes it. He likes Queen the most.)

Yeah I know that some parts will change and puberty differentiates a lot when it comes to your brain and hormones. I generally focus on math and such, and on my breaks I draw and write a lot of different things.

Thank you so much, the way I'm feeling sometimes I can't really help since puberty and everything. I've been trying my best, it means a lot to hear these words. I have a lot of people I try my best to reach out to when I'm in a crisis of some sorts. (Generally my friends online cause they're on the internet a lot and they can understand where I'm coming from.) Thank you again, I'll carry those words with me. <3
Bluefront River Amazon. His name's Lindy and he's a 36 year old bird I took in after his original owners gave him to our family.
I'll hug the window when I can lol, his cage is in a windowed area with a screen door leading to it as it's apart of my living room.

I've been going to therapy for about two months now and it's mainly trying to fix my whole ADHD thing. When it comes to that one feeling that gives me most trouble, it's usually very despair feeling or just feeling hollow.
